subject: Priority slot addendum — temporary burst allowance / token pool
messages:
From: Sara Patel <sara.patel@equinoxhealth.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: short-term priority slot for controlled rollout / SLA ask

Hi Jasmine,

Quick note from Equinox: we're doing a staged roll‑out of a new real‑time triage feature the week of Nov 30. Traffic profile will spike for several ~30‑minute windows per day during the beta (see attached forecast). Our platform is latency‑sensitive — 95th percentile token latency target is 150ms for inference calls used in the critical path.

Two asks: can Redwood provision a short‑term priority slot (isolated token pool or temporary higher priority lane) for Nov 30–Dec 2 so we don't get throttled by fair‑share during the rollout, and can we get an SLA addendum that documents the temporary uplift and fallback behavior? We understand this is an exception; we're happy to sign an addendum and pay an upgrade.

What we can provide: a 72‑hour load window plan and a usage sample (attached). Please let me know what information you need from our side and the fastest path to get this in place.

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Patel
Head of Platform Engineering — Equinox Health
Attachments: monthly-load-forecast.csv, usage_sample.json
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Patel <sara.patel@equinoxhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 10:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: short-term priority slot for controlled rollout / SLA ask

Hi Sara — thanks for the details and the forecast. This is doable in principle, and we have two options we typically offer for short, high‑priority windows: (A) a temporary "priority token pool" (isolated bucket of tokens for your account for the requested windows) or (B) a routing rule that pins a percentage of requests to dedicated capacity with a surcharge.

Quick questions to size this properly:
- Peak concurrent QPS in the 30‑min windows? (approx. requests/sec)
- Average tokens per request in that path?
- Are there any PII/data residency constraints for the requests?

If you confirm QPS + tokens, I can route to Ben for pricing and to Legal/CS for a short addendum. Ben — can you review feasibility (kernel/queue limits) and give a ballpark uplift price? If we can get this provisioned as a managed priority pool, we can do a 72‑hour window starting Nov 30 if we sign the addendum by COB Nov 24.

Best,
Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 14:37:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: Equinox temporary priority slot — feasibility & price

Grace / Aditya — quick internal note on Equinox's request. Attached is a sizing attempt based on their forecast (I used the sample usage). Short version: feasible with a token pool carved out of a shared GPU group; the runtime can enforce a per‑customer token bucket and a short TTL KV cache to keep latency stable, but there are two operational constraints:

1) Kernel/slot fragmentation: carving a pool reduces available capacity for others; to avoid SLO regressions we need to limit the pool size and enforce hard caps.
2) Monitoring + rollback: we must instrument an automated fallback path that routes to standard fair‑share when underlying utilization exceeds the agreed emergency threshold.

Pricing suggestion: $X per 10M tokens for the 72‑hour window + flat provisioning fee (covers ops runbook and manual provisioning). I'll attach a simple price worksheet. If sales agrees, Legal should draft a very short addendum specifying the priority window, token allotment, surcharge, start/end times, and the fallback clause.

Attachments: priority-pool-pricing.xlsx

Ben
Sr. Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Patel <sara.patel@equinoxhealth.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:21:00 -0800
Subject: Equinox — proposed short addendum & mutual action plan (Nov 30–Dec 2)

Hi Sara — thanks again for the forecast. We've discussed internally and can offer a short addendum that authorizes a temporary priority slot for Nov 30 00:00 PST through Dec 2 23:59 PST with the following guardrails:

- Token allotment: 60M tokens total for the 72‑hour window (isolated token pool attached to your account).
- Latency objective: target 95th percentile inference latency <= 150ms for requests served from the priority pool; non‑binding but measurable for the addendum.
- Fallback behavior: automatic fallback to your existing fair‑share routing when cluster utilization across the selected region exceeds 85% for >5 minutes.
- Cancellation & rollback: Redwood reserves the right to revoke priority pool access if the pool causes platform‑wide SLO risk; in that case we'll provide post‑mortem and credit per the addendum terms.

We will provision the pool once the addendum is executed; we can start provisioning as early as Nov 26 to allow a dry run and validation ahead of your rollout. Pricing and the DocuSign link are in the addendum.

I've attached Equinox_SLA_Addendum_v1.pdf for review; if this looks good we can route to DocuSign and aim for signature by COB Nov 24.

Thanks — Grace
Grace O'Connor
Director, Customer Success, Redwood Inference
Attachments: Equinox_SLA_Addendum_v1.pdf
From: Sara Patel <sara.patel@equinoxhealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 17:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Equinox — proposed short addendum & mutual action plan (Nov 30–Dec 2)

Grace — this looks good and aligns with what we need. Two quick clarifications: we can commit to the 60M token allotment if we can confirm the 95th percentile measurement point (is it measured at the instance ingress or after your routing proxy?) and we'd like a one‑hour dry run on Nov 28 if provisioning is ready Nov 26.

We'll sign the addendum via DocuSign as soon as you send the link; target start Nov 30 as planned. Please escalate provisioning if it cannot be ready by Nov 26.

I'll have our PM countersign as well.

Sara
Head of Platform Engineering, Equinox Health
